inputs.goal: colloquio di lavoro, domande sullo stipendio

findings.detail: scene 1: 1 must_say items start with ask (at least 2)

scenes.topic_description:
Situation: You are in a job interview with the person assessing your application. This first part focuses on your background, your previous work, and your reasons for applying before practical conditions are discussed.
Learner: Candidate. Partner: Interviewer.
Not in this scene: salary, benefits, contract details, next steps after the interview.
must_say: give your name — slot: the name
say what position you are applying for — slot: the position
say where you worked before — slot: the workplace
say what your main duties were — slot: the duties
explain why you want this job — slot: the reason
ask what the team works on — slot: the work area
must_understand: asks which position you are applying for
asks about your previous workplace and duties
asks why you want this job
says what the role involves day to day

scenes.topic_description:
Situation: Later in the same interview, the conversation turns to pay and conditions. The learner is especially worried about salary questions, so this is the core scene where compensation is clarified and expectations are discussed.
Learner: Candidate. Partner: Interviewer.
Not in this scene: introductions, work history, daily duties, detailed next steps after the interview.
must_say: ask what salary range is offered — slot: the position
ask whether the salary is gross or net — slot: the salary figure
ask how often salary is paid — slot: the pay period
ask whether there are bonuses or benefits — slot: the benefit
explain your salary expectation — slot: the amount or range
ask whether the amount is negotiable — slot: the amount
confirm what is included in the offer — slot: the item included
must_understand: says the salary range for the role
explains whether the amount is gross or net
tells how often employees are paid
offers information about bonuses or benefits
asks what salary you are expecting
